decisions.reason: As a 2023 line still promoted on its own page in 2024 and closely aligned with the firm's core lighting-system know-how, it fits existing capabilities and is likely worth refining rather than withdrawing.
This ceiling luminaire line is close to the established offer and remained prominently marketed across two years, which suggests enough fit and learning potential to keep it in the range.
Although newly launched in 2024, it is strongly related to the firm's existing spotlight competence, so absorptive capacity arguments favor keeping it long enough to learn and improve.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy builds directly on the firm's modular lighting business and complements system sales, making retention more likely than early removal.
This low-voltage canopy is somewhat more specialized but still uses adjacent knowledge and supports the firm's adaptable-system positioning, so it is more likely to be kept than dropped.
Despite weaker website prominence in 2024, the round glass track luminaires remain close to the firm's design-led core and are likely to be given more time before any withdrawal decision.
